messages:
faiz: FYI we started getting intermittent 413s from Wavelet canary targeting /v1/embeddings. Preflight said OK. Any thoughts?
gina: Saw that. Payloads are mixed dims (512 + 1024) and fairly dense. Preflight estimator `embed.unit_estimator_v2` reports low units but runtime enforces per-shard byte caps.
harry: Can you share a sample request summary (no PII)?
faiz: Sure: batch=8, dims=[512,1024,1024,512,512,1024,768,768], total_bytes ~380KB. Preflight -> units=8, Runtime -> 413 from shard-9.
ivy: This smells like fragmentation: routing assigned uneven slots and one shard exceeded its soft cap. Preflight assumes perfectly packable slots.
gina: UX problem: Console label reads "Estimated units" and customers assume it's exact. We should change to "Preflight estimate (may differ at runtime)".
harry: Implementation idea: add an opt-in RPC to router that gives a shard-aware verdict. Cheap call: return {decision, suggested_split} so preflight can surface accurate guidance.
jack: Also add an API header so clients can request the router-backed estimate: `X-Embed-Prefer-Routing: true` and `X-Embed-Shape-Hint: 512,1024,1024,512...`.
faiz: If router says split, preflight should return a 200 with `warning: "split_recommended"` and `split_hint: 2` so client SDKs can auto-split.
infra-bot: Ticket created INF-4599 "router-aware preflight and split_hint" assigned to jack.
gina: Telemetry: tag preflight events with `router_checked=true/false`, `router_decision=allow|split|reject`, and increment `embed.preflight_runtime_disagree` when runtime returns 413 after preflight allow.
ivy: Dashboard: new panel for per-tenant mismatch rate and a burn alert if mismatch > 0.25% over 30m for production tenants. Keeps support noise low.
harry: Rollout plan: feature flag `router_preflight_v1` behind tenant opt-in. Start with Wavelet and two other high-volume tenants, 5% traffic initially.
jack: For mixed-dim heuristics, router can also provide a `pack_score` (0-1) to indicate packing quality; show it in Console as "Estimated packability: 0.72".
gina: Console copy: "Preflight estimate (approx). Toggle 'accurate preflight' to consult routing for shard-aware guidance; may add ~20-40ms to preflight." Ivy will draft.
faiz: Backwards compat: when router unavailable, preflight falls back to global estimator and sets `router_checked=false` in telemetry.
ivy: API docs update: sample preflight request and response including `split_hint` and example header usage. Will add a short note in the changelog.
jack: Runtime change: when we perform an automatic split we should include `split_meta: {parts:2, per_part_bytes:[210000,170000]}` in response if `X-Embed-Want-Split-Advice: true`. Opt-in to avoid noise.
harry: Agreed. Keep default compact.
gina: I'll wire an alert in Grafana for `embed.preflight_runtime_disagree` with paging if mismatch spikes quickly.
faiz: Thanks team. Next step: jack prototype router RPC, gina console copy + panel, ivy docs, harry flag rollout plan. Sync in 48h.
